shortdesc: Simple live Cups for 2–8 racers: one track pick each, finalist scoring, smooth POV spectating, PB and record panels.

0.2.0: Replace seeding, captains and semifinals with one shared Cup for any 2–8 racers.
Racers join themselves and choose one native-library track each; duplicate picks collapse and the order is shuffled.
100-point target; 10/8/6/5/4/3/2/1 scoring; the first finalist to win a later round wins the Cup.
Lower race HUD with clearer point gains, finalist markers, rank movement and car skins.
Add overall WR, scored Cup session record (TR), and the watched racer’s overall PB.
Preserve buffered POV spectating and organizer void, undo, reconnect and export controls.
Use PolyCup branding throughout the current release and PolyTrack’s bundled ForcedSquare typography.
